detail.longDescription: One again I'm dipping briefly into the bottomless well of weirdness that is Harry Potter and the Methods of Rationality , and once again I recommend Strange Æons on the subject: https:// youtu.be/TKMzmOYcEUE One of the most striking aspects of the subculture which Yudkowsky has built round himself through his relentless marketing of himself as a revolutionary thinker who will change your life forever (as they all promise) is the degree to which human perfection is described in the familiar jargon of # computing and # programming . (cont'd)
